first_reader_said: EZR 7:1: Both records are Seraiah son of Azariah and father (ancestor) of Ezra.

why: EZR 7:1 identifies Seraiah through Azariah and Hilkiah, matching the priestly lineage of B; 1CH 6:14 also names Seraiah as Azariah’s son and Jehozadak’s father. Ezra’s later appearance does not require another Seraiah, since the genealogy can identify an ancestor rather than an immediate father. A is a thinner copy of B, which also includes the chief priest named in 2KI 25:18 and JER 52:24.
